# Ballard's Barbershop

> Classic barbershop with an upscale vibe in downtown Belmont, NC. Established 1949. Classic cuts, modern style.

Ballard's Barbershop is a classic community barbershop with a modern vibe at 200 N. Main St., Belmont, NC 28012. Phone: 704.741.1900. Hours: Monday–Friday 9am–7pm; Saturday 8am–3pm.

In 1949, William Henry "Bill" Ballard set up shop and Ballard's Barbershop was born. For decades it was a pillar in the Belmont community — a place where men came for a quality cut and good conversation. Reimagined in 2019, the shop found a new home at 200 N Main Street in downtown Belmont. The location is new; the spirit is the same: relax, catch up with friends, and leave looking your best.

The shop is a classic barbershop with an upscale vibe, small town charm, and all things dapper.

Services (prices vary by barber): Classic Cut $30+; Buzz Cut $25+; Head Shave $40+; Lineups $20+. Packages: The Refiner $45 (precision cut and hot lather shave; the gentleman with a full beard); The Classic $55 (precision cut and full hot lather shave); The Signature $65 (precision cut, full hot lather shave, and a relaxing facial). All shaves come complete with hot towels, pre shave oil, hot lather, and a cold towel finish.

Master barbers: Dustin Prince, Rob Bumgardner, Dustin Helms, Ed Trevino, Ray Goodson, Dustin Goodson, and Bryan Walls.

Book an appointment online or call 704.741.1900. The homepage includes schema.org BarberShop structured data.
